title: enroll refuses on role hooks in the user claude layer, and no verb clears them
description:
## .the defect

a role hook in the user claude layer (`~/.claude/settings.json`) has no rhachet verb that owns it. `rhx enroll` reads that layer, finds a hook of a role the clone is not enrolled in, and refuses. no `rhx init --hooks`, `rhx roles init`, or `rhx roles link` rewrites or prunes the user layer. a driver on the grove cannot clear the leak; only a hand edit of a shared human file can.

seen on rhachet 1.53.0 (host) and 1.51.0 (lockfile pin). `assertCloneSettingsLayersHoldOnlyEnrolledRoles` is in both.

## .the refusal, verbatim

```
✋ ConstraintError: a clone would load hooks from roles it is not enrolled in

{
  "hint": "your home claude settings hold role hooks; remove every hook whose `author` names a `role=` from the file(s) above, then enroll again",
  "rolesEnrolled": [
    "reviewer",
    "behaver",
    "ergonomist",
    "mechanic"
  ],
  "leaks": [
    {
      "event": "PreToolUse",
      "author": "repo=bhrain/role=learner",
      "source": "user",
      "path": "/home/camper/.claude/settings.json"
    },
    {
      "event": "Stop",
      "author": "repo=bhuild/role=dispatcher",
      "source": "user",
      "path": "/home/camper/.claude/settings.json"
    }
  ]
}
```

## .the cost

ehmpathy/rhachet-roles-bhrain, route `v2026_11_21.fix-driver-runs-budget-lever`, stone `5.3.verification`: all three level-3 review lanes spawn a clone via `rhx enroll claude …` and refuse at this check, two rounds in a row. the judge counts each unread lane as a blocker, so the stone cannot pass.

## .the shape of the fix

- a verb that owns role hooks in the user layer, e.g. `rhx init --hooks --scope user --mode prune` (plan by default): list every hook whose `author` names a `role=`; remove them on apply
- the enroll refusal hint names that verb, so the fix is one paste
- deeper: find which path wrote role hooks into the user layer at all, and stop it there
